[P2] Mark terminal invocations before releasing the clock

`settled` remains false while `handleCompletedExecution()` awaits its final worker update, but `invokeHandler()` already calls `releaseTimedCompletions()` during that interval. If an invoked function completed with an unanswered callback in an early-completed parallel, `pendingOperations` makes this method return true, bypassing the coordinator's result-handoff guard. For example, a child racing a one-hour wait against a callback can return at hour one, yet a sibling three-hour wait advances the clock before the caller receives that result. A subsequent one-hour caller wait then ends at hour four instead of hour two. Record terminal invocation state before releasing the clock, and report no pending work during that handoff regardless of abandoned operations. Add coverage for this invoked-function case.
